text:
elena: FYI I ran the telemetry sample and noticed two problems: the console prints full prompts at INFO and traces don't have a request id. repro steps below.
todd: can you paste a log line and how you ran it?
elena: ran examples/telemetry-js with `REDACT_PROMPT=true node example.js` and saw: `INFO 2026-07-14T08:10:05Z route=/chat prompt=\"private plan\" request_id=- sample=telemetry-js`
ben: hyphen for request_id means transport never added it. OTEL spans missing `redwood.request_id` too?
elena: yep, no `redwood.request_id` attribute in spans. So we can't correlate logs->traces.
todd: JS SDK should mirror python/go: inject `x-request-id` header on outbound requests and set span attribute `redwood.request_id`. Looks like the fetch wrapper rewrite moved reqId generation but didn't expose it to logger/otel.
ben: and redaction is only applied for ERROR logs in src/logger.js right now. If REDACT_PROMPT=true we should redact at all levels (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR) to avoid accidental PII leakage.
elena: quick grep shows raw prompts still appear: `node example.js | grep -E "prompt=\""` returns matches even with REDACT_PROMPT=true. bad for demos.
todd: minimal fixes: 1) surface reqId from transport into the request context so logger defaultMeta can include it 2) OTEL hook should read reqId from same context at span start and set `redwood.request_id` 3) move prompt redaction into a pre-format logger filter that runs for all levels when REDACT_PROMPT=true.
ben: example filter (pseudo):
```js
logger.addFilter(record => {
  if (process.env.REDACT_PROMPT === 'true') {
    record.message = record.message.replace(/prompt=\"[^\"]*\"/g, 'prompt=\"[REDACTED]\"')
  }
  return true
})
```
ben: OTEL snippet after reqId is known: `const span = api.trace.getSpan(context.active()); if (span) span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id', reqId)`
elena: I'll prototype a small patch that: generates reqId at transport start, attaches it to the request context, updates logger defaultMeta, and updates the otel hook to set the span attribute. Will also add the logger prefilter for redaction.
todd: please include unit tests that run through DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR and assert that raw prompts are absent when REDACT_PROMPT=true. Regex checks are fine. Also add a tiny CI job in examples/telemetry-js/.github/workflows/ci.yml that runs the example and fails if stdout contains `prompt="`.
ben: +1 on CI check. We should also document the conventions in docs/devex/telemetry.md: header `x-request-id` for logs, span attribute `redwood.request_id`, and show the logger.addFilter example.
infra-bot: Created issue #3120: "js-sdk: propagate request_id to logs & OTEL; redact prompts at all log levels in samples" (https://redwood.internal/issue/3120) :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Created workflow run examples/telemetry-js-ci for branch telemetry/requestid-redact by elena.
elena: I'll open a draft PR with before/after logs in description and the test/CI changes. ETA tomorrow morning. Will ping for reviews.
todd: thanks! if you want pair on OTEL wiring I can pair after lunch.
ben: small perf note: logger prefilter should be cheap (single regex) and opt-in via env var. Avoid heavy parsing on hot paths.
elena: ack. will keep it simple and document the tradeoffs.
